Message:
IB/qib: Add err_decode() call for ring dump

Commit 0b3ddf380ca7 ("Log all SDMA errors unconditionally") missed
part of the patch.

This also corrects a format warning when dma_addr_t is 32 bits
on a 64 bit system.
